_comment: The week in the DFFL. The scheduled job appends one object to weeks[] after each week finalizes: a lede, a write-up for each of the six games, and an 'around' notebook covering everything else that moved that week. The site sorts newest-first and computes the risers and sliders itself from its own power rankings, so nothing here should ever quote a rank or a movement.

weeks[].lede: one paragraph on the week as a whole - the shape of it, what mattered, what it set up

around[].kind: one of: trade, waivers, riser, slider, streak, injury, race, note
around[].headline: short, factual
